failure_reason: Category tree/hierarchy and every recorded URL were confirmed via tier-a HTTP calls (robots.txt OK; homepage 200; /api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json 200 giving the real mega-menu names/ids; /netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz 200 confirming each URL is indexed). However every /shop/<dept>/<slug>/ category LISTING page itself is blocked: curl_cffi (chrome124 impersonation) returns 403 'due to website restrictions' or times out (curl 28) on /shop/ and /search/ paths specifically (homepage and /api/ paths are unaffected). Escalated to tier b: Playwright headless got 403; Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled succeeded once (200, correct title/canonical) but the product grid never rendered within the capture window (totalProductsCount stayed 0, 0 product-tile nodes) - likely an Akamai bot-challenge plus a client-side email-signup modal blocking the lazy-loaded grid; repeat attempts on the same tier then returned 403 or navigation timeout (system was also under heavy concurrent load - 187 concurrent chrome.exe processes observed from other parallel batch workers sharing this machine). Escalated to tier c: mcp__claude-in-chrome tools report the browser extension is not connected in this environment, so tier c was unavailable. Net effect: category structure/classification is HIGH-confidence and URL-verified, but qty could not be read for any row - every row is qty=null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than a fabricated/estimated number.
notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP via curl_cffi (chrome124 impersonation) - robots.txt (200, no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai disallow, generic User-agent:* has ordinary path disallows only, not a blanket block) and homepage (200) succeeded, but all /shop/ category-listing pages and /search/ returned 403 'RESTRICTED ACCESS ERROR' or curl timeout(28); the /api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json endpoint and the sitemap gzip files (ecm/shop-sitemap) were NOT blocked and returned 200. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright: headless got 403 on /shop/rugs/; headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled got one clean 200 (title 'Rugs | Rejuvenation', correct canonical) but product grid/count never populated after modal-dismiss + scroll + up to 6s wait, and subsequent repeat attempts hit 403/timeout again (concurrent-worker load on shared machine, 187 chrome.exe processes observed). Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome: mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp reported the browser extension is not connected - tier c unavailable, stopped per first-block rule. TREE: built from the union of (1) the site's own /api/catalog/v1/category/categorytree/shop/data.json mega-menu JSON (authoritative names/ids/nesting for every top-nav department: Rugs, Bedding & Decor, Bath, Kitchen, Bedroom, Organization, Outdoor, Furniture, Hardware, Lighting, Mirrors, Vintage, Sale, New and Featured) and (2) /netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz (801 URLs, confirms every recorded slug is a real indexed /shop/<dept>/<slug>/ page). Every recorded URL was cross-checked present in the sitemap; 'Canisters & Containers' (tree id=canisters-containers, would-be Storage row) was DROPPED because its URL never appears anywhere in the shop sitemap and could not be independently confirmed - not recorded rather than guessing the URL. QTY: could not be read for any row (see failure_reason) - all qty=null, flag='MANUAL REVIEW: qty unavailable - site blocks automated product-count reads on /shop/ pages (403/timeout across HTTP and headed-Playwright tiers); Claude-in-Chrome unavailable in this environment. Category/URL confirmed via categorytree API + sitemap (tier a, 200 OK).' EXCLUDED (textile-adjacent, not recorded): Rugs 'Rugs by Style' facet group (Hand-Knotted & Hand-Loomed, Flatweave, Bold, Neutral, Warm Tones, Cool Tones, Patterned, Hand-Loomed Rugs) - construction/color facets layered over the same Area-Rugs catalog, not primary taxonomy; 'Rug Swatches' - fabric samples not rugs; 'All Rugs'/'Rugs' top parent - subcats exist (parent-URL rule); 'Curtain Swatches' - samples; 'Poufs' - furniture (fabric ottoman), matches textile.md furniture-boundary example; 'All Pillows & Bedding'/'Pillows & Throws' umbrella - dropped in favor of the granular 'Pillows' and 'Throws' leaf subcats per the parent-URL rule; Bedroom department's own 'Bedding' node (id=bedding) - same category reached via a second nav path as Decor's 'Bedding' (id=all-bedding), kept only the Decor one to avoid a same-content duplicate; Outdoor department's 'Doormats'/'Indoor & Outdoor Rugs' - duplicate cross-links into the same Rugs-department catalog already recorded once; Wall Art/Wallpaper/Wreaths, Clocks, Candles & Home Fragrance, Decorative Bowls & Trays, Vases, Fireplace items, Planters - Wall Decor/Decorative-Accessories/Kitchen&Dining boundary, out of scope; all named '...Collection' nodes (Audrey, Stafford Basket, Coyuchi Bedding, seasonal print collections, etc.) - branded product-line collections, not generic categories; all 'New Arrivals', 'Bestsellers', 'In-Stock & Quick Ship', 'Sale'/'Clearance' nodes - promotional/inventory facets, not primary taxonomy; Pet Accessories, Cleaning Supplies - pet/cleaning-tool boundary. EXCLUDED (storage-adjacent, not recorded): 'All Storage Furniture', 'Bookshelves', 'Consoles & Credenzas', 'Desks' (all under Organization dept) - furniture-boundary items per storage.md Sec21 (bookcase/console/desk are listed as Potential Furniture even when a site nests them under an Organization/Storage tab); 'Bath Furniture & Storage' - name is furniture-led, excluded per furniture boundary; 'Teak Bathroom Accessories', 'Hart Modular Shelving', 'Holgate Modular Shelving', 'Korbo Woven Wire Baskets', 'Steele Canvas Collection' - branded collections; 'Kitchen & Pantry' header's own children are all linkcat cross-links (Pot Racks/Pantry Organizers/Decorative Bowls & Trays/shelving all resolve to nodes already recorded once under Kitchen or Decor) - not re-recorded; 'Easy Updates: Storage & Organization', 'Home Office Essentials' sibling marketing pages, 'All Closet & Shelving'/'All Shelving & Hooks'/'All Laundry & Bath Organization' parent-all pages where a granular child exists, 'All Organization' top parent - parent-URL rule; 'Canisters & Containers' - URL unverifiable in sitemap crawl, dropped rather than invented.
